title: Chapter 743
paragraphs: Chapter 743
Episode 184. Beyond Fate (15)
"Jin must have broken the sphere!"
"Check the Lafrarosa footage! The location is suspected to be the God-fighting field. Is that person a God-fighter!?"

"Yes, she's a God-fighter. Female, significantly smaller than other royal clan members. Matches exactly what Jin drew for us. Looking at the shape of her mouth and her shining heart, it seems the God-fighting Union was also successfully achieved!"
Hupester, a remote island.
This is the uninhabited island where Jin first accidentally experienced a 'connection' with Ring-Ring after he had finished his total offensive on the first Sword Garden and escaped.
From the moment Jin broke the sphere in the castle of the monster, the gold wire tribe members who had been waiting here were screaming with excitement.
"I understand that you're excited because it was successful, but lower your voices. It interferes with the focus of our feline tribe friends."

Peng raised his index finger to his lips and said. The gold wire tribe members were able to see the image of Lafrarosa thanks to the unique dimensional ability of the feline tribe, and the machine developed by Quaul and Valeria. Next to the image, the members of the feline tribe were chanting spells with their eyes rolled back.
"Peng is right. Everyone focus and inspect the image properly, if there's a problem, notify me immediately. I need to adjust this now."

Quaul said, sitting in front of a machine that looked like a giant wind chime. The image of Lafrarosa that the gold wire tribe members were watching was being transmitted from the other side of that machine.

As Quaul pressed the keys that looked like piano keys, the transmitted image became clearer. On the other hand, if Quaul didn't press the keys or made a mistake in the calculations and pressed them, the image became blurred.
The clearer the image, the higher the synchronization rate between Jin and Lafrarosa, and the blurrier it became, the lower it got.
'Waveform Tracking Synchronization Device'

That was the official name of the red sphere that Jin broke and the wind chime-shaped machine. As the name suggests, the Waveform Tracking Synchronization Device was a device created based on the technology used in the space-time device and the Red Owl.
Also, the information obtained from analyzing 'mass teleportation through chaos' during the last Rekatten invasion played a major role.
Of course, the ultimate goal of Tikan using this device was to bring out the royal clan members of Lafrarosa as a reward.

Now, synchronizing Jin and Lafrarosa is the limit, and even that is only possible if the device is installed directly on this uninhabited island. However, it was proving to be an invaluable aid in the final battle.
Sweat was pouring down from Quaul's forehead as he manipulated the keys. The adjustment was difficult, but he was taken aback by an unexpected variable.
'The synchronization rate... is excessively high compared to the experimental value! Why? Is there some variable in the space called the monster's castle?'
A high synchronization rate means that the fusion of Jin and Vahn is going well, but it also increases the probability of side effects. The device was unstable, just as Valeria had feared.
The machine was heating up as if it were on fire.
'Firstly, I need to adjust as best as I can... I can only hope that the machine holds up until Jin finishes the fight!'
Quaul clenched his teeth and hit the keys. The image was becoming more and more clear.
Jin's body was dyed blue.

Even while standing still, the aura emanating from his body distorted the surroundings. Instead of Jin's usual calm and cold feeling, it overflowed with a destructive atmosphere that seemed like it would ruthlessly annihilate the enemy.
'That's... God-fighting fusion?'
'Just like the Bull Divination using the Demon Stone, he transforms into a completely different person...'
The allies thought as they looked at Jin's back. The Vamel alliance had shared information about the God-fighting fusion with the temporary allies before the final battle began.
The monster felt the sudden change in Jin's energy and licked its lips.

Whenever an unexpected event occurred while dealing with Jin, she felt a kind of pleasure. The only joy left in the monster's world, which could have been more boring, more desolate, was the battle with Jin.
Clang!
With a sharp sound of collision, Jin disappeared from everyone's sight.
With speed fast enough to even lose the monster's track in an instant, Jin had leaped over the monster's head and was striking down with Sigmund.
Disturbing the creation of aura with mixed energy, and disorienting the inner mind with mental attacks.
Such elements cannot work on a God-fighter. Jin was now exhibiting God-fighting fusion with higher synchronization than ever before.
A single sword falling like thunder.
At the same time, hundreds of arms attached to the monster's body swung weapons. Swords larger than the castle's pillars moved swiftly as if ignoring mass.
However, as soon as they touched Sigmund, the swords just shattered like glass. Even with hundreds of swords that could shatter a mountain in an instant, they could not stop the God-fighter's sword.
Zuaaak-!

The monster's chest split open like a bell. The black mixed energy spilling out like blood soaked the floor, and before Jin's feet touched the wet ground, he twisted his body in mid-air and struck his sword horizontally.
The monster, split in a cross shape, stepped back and spit out a breath of mixed energy.
Therefore, whenever Jin breathed in, the mixed energy infiltrated, but the God-fighter's blood and the mad heart did not allow the mixed energy to accumulate in his body.
[How delightful...!]
The monster vomited a chunk of bloody mixed energy and spat out a laugh filled with madness. The shattered swords regained their form, and the body split into a cross recovered.
Jin didn't bother chasing the distanced monster.
Instead, he extended the oppression of the King's sword.

As the aura concentrated in Sigmund began to cause a gravitational pull, the entire space around the monster seemed to vibrate as if it would collapse. Then the huge body of the monster was seen being drawn towards Jin.
It was a strange sight.
All of the monster's swords were sticking to Jin's sword, even though he stood still. The stacked swords tangled and shattered haphazardly, and the brilliance of Sigmund became deeper.
The aura flowing along the shattered fragments distorted the monster's body. It seemed as if a giant hand was grabbing the monster's flesh and tearing it apart.
The monster, which had endured even the enormous eternal heat, was cut and exploded repeatedly every moment.
[Really? Let's see if you can still be glad when your disgraceful life completely ends.]
A being that was probably the peak throughout history, even within the Star Clan.
Jin, merged with God-fighter Vahn, was overwhelming the monster in an instant.
(Jin brothers, how long can we maintain our connection?)

‘I heard about an hour from the developer of the connection device, but it will definitely be shorter than that. My synchronization rate with the God-fighter brothers is much higher than he mentioned. Therefore, the device can't help but withstand less time.’
(In addition, the synchronization rate is continuously increasing in real time. The God-fighter fusion is even clearer than when the brothers were in Lafrarosa.)
The monster has not yet fully revealed all its power. It was difficult to estimate the total amount of power that the monster possessed with Vahn's senses.
But there was no time for exploration. As long as the God-fighter fusion lasted, it had to deal as much damage to the monster as possible.
(Let's just break it until it can't regenerate.)
The gravitational pull of oppression began to surge rapidly.
Now the monster's whole body was twisted as if it was going to be absorbed into the body of Sigmund's sword.

Literally, it was dimensionally different from the oppression Jin had used so far. The original purpose of oppression was simply to limit the opponent's movements, but Vahn's oppression possessed the monstrous strength to grab the opponent and crush them in itself.
[This is indeed a shocking sword, but wouldn't it be insufficient to kill this mother? The physical damage has long lost its meaning to me.]
Mixed energy gushed out like a fountain from the hollow eye socket of the monster's distorted face.

The mixed energy that spewed out like that flowed like a torrent on the ground, moving towards the allies behind Jin. Without even having to check, if the concentration was this high, those without resistance like Jin would experience serious exposure just by getting grazed.
Fortunately, most of it evaporated due to Jin's aura and disappeared somewhere. The mixed energy that passed Jin couldn't penetrate the superhuman's techniques and fleet bombardment.
However, the monster was getting more massive each time it spewed mixed energy from its body.
'It wasn't suitable for battle, only imposing in terms of outward pressure, even before it got bigger. Getting even bigger would be of no use against me and my brother, Vahn. Then...'
A few seconds later, Jin guessed what the monster was thinking.
'Vahn, it's a self-destruct.'
(It intends to self-destruct.)
Jin and Vahn spoke simultaneously.
As the monster's body grew, the battlefield was shrinking. The mixed energy that made up this fortress was being returned to the monster in its entirety.
Of course, it wasn't a true self-destruct.
The monster planned to explode its infinitely massive body and infect everyone here with chaos.
The only one who could survive that explosion was Jin, who had immunity.
[...Hehe, isn't it time for the underlings to disappear? So as not to interfere with our fight. But again, I am excited for this.]
The monster voiced with a tone filled with ecstasy.
[I intend to kill all those who followed you by infecting them with chaos. How many of them can you save?]
Immediately after those words.
Suddenly, the ceiling was disappearing. The abruptly opened sky was entirely black, and Jin and his allies soon found out why.
It wasn't the sky but the underside of the warship Ram. The main cannon of Ram, protruding monstrously, was opened towards the ground.
"That, that's..."
"Quickly, the shield...!"
There was no space to dodge Ram's main cannon in the narrowed battlefield.
And those who had experienced the first joint attack knew all too well that the fleet's shields were meaningless in front of Ram's main cannon.
Not just the main cannon, but also the monster's mixed energy explosion was added.

Orgal seemed to be flustered and shook his head. There was nothing Orgal could do if the main cannon hit directly in this state. His best judgment was to evacuate to the steel doors with the most important individuals.
However, Jin, looking down at somewhere on the monster's body stuck to Sigmund, responded like this.
[All of them.]
As soon as the answer fell, the aura of Sigmund, which was forming oppression, changed.
Kingdom Ruling Sword.
The five phases of the God-fighter had begun.
